deliverables: 12 months of operations from August 2026 to July 2027
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Conversion of up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins with any excess Ada returned to the treasury
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, infrastructure, support, administration, and audits/oversight.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover around $420,000 in annual costs for a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposed budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to administration, and 2% to audits.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for company users, and says about 5,500 paying users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs.
The proposal states that up to $420,000 worth of Ada will be converted into stablecoins and deposited into a public company wallet, with excess Ada returned to the treasury.

The proposal states that independent audits of treasury fund use will occur in February 2027 and August 2027 and will review custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

Eternl commits to assessing repayment every December and June, using surplus remaining treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada value has been repaid.
Eternl states that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the npm registry.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of Eternl operations, gives a category budget and sustainability/payback plan, but several adoption and impact claims are asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
